tools.name: search_bridges
tools.description: Search US bridges in the FHWA National Bridge Inventory. Scope with state, county (3-digit FIPS code), and/or condition (Good/Fair/Poor); optional filters: posting_status (open/posted/closed/not_yet_open), owner_code, scour_critical, year_min/year_max, min_adt, route, and q (text match on facility c

tools.name: get_bridge
tools.description: Get one bridge by its FHWA structure number (Item 8). Structure numbers are unique within a state; pass state to be exact. Returns the full decoded record.

tools.name: list_bridges_in_county
tools.description: List bridges in one county (state + 3-digit FIPS county code), paged.

tools.name: get_worst_bridges
tools.description: The worst-rated bridges in a state (condition = Poor), ordered by lowest component rating then age. State is required. Use for 'worst bridges in X' questions.

tools.name: list_posted_or_closed_bridges
tools.description: Bridges in a state that are load-posted or closed to traffic (NBI Item 41 status P/R/K), worst condition first. Relevant for routing and heavy-haul feasibility — but per FHWA, NBI data must not be used as the sole source for route clearance; inspections can be up to ~24 months old.

tools.name: find_low_clearance_bridges
tools.description: Bridges in a state whose vertical clearance is at or below max_height_m (or max_height_ft in feet — pass one, not both). Default clearance is over the roadway on the bridge (NBI Item 10); set under=true for the clearance under the bridge (Item 54B), which is what matters for routes passing beneath.

tools.name: get_state_summary
tools.description: Bridge summary for one state: total bridges, counts by condition (Good/Fair/Poor), posted and closed counts, scour-critical count, average year built, total deck area. Without a state, returns per-state totals with condition counts for all states.

tools.name: get_county_summaries
tools.description: Per-county bridge counts for a state, with Poor-condition and posted/closed counts per county.

tools.name: find_bridges_nearby
tools.description: Bridges near a point, nearest first. Pass lat/lon in decimal degrees; radius_km defaults to 10 (max 500). Each returned bridge carries distance_km. Bridges with no coordinates are excluded. Unlike the state-scoped tools, this one takes no state — the point is the scope.

tools.name: screen_corridor
tools.description: Screen a corridor for a vehicle profile: pass a route polyline as points (array of {lat, lon} objects tracing the actual road — submit a real route trace, not city points) plus a vehicle height and weight, and get back every bridge near the corridor that fails the profile, fails first then warnings,

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "screen_corridor" is 1405 chars, far longer than this server's median (259). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_low_clearance_bridges" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Bridges in a state whose vertical clearance is at or below max_height_m. Default clearance is over the roadway on the bridge (NBI Item 10); set under=true for the clearance under the bridge (Item 54B), which is what matters for routes passing beneath. Sentinel 'no restriction' values are excluded." → after: "Bridges in a state whose vertical clearance is at or below max_height_m (or max_height_ft in feet — pass one, not both). Default clearance is over the roadway on the bridge (NBI Item 10); set under=true for the clearance under the bridge (Item 54B), which is what matters for routes passing beneath. "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
